title: pollinia ciliata var. formosana
intro: Pollinia ciliata var. formosana, commonly known as Formosa pollinia, is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Formosa pollinia include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
